title: Subpanel Feed Continuity Inspection Summary
brief: Draft an electrical continuity and insulation resistance test report summarizing field measurements for the general contractor.

delegate.scenario: A journeyman electrician completed initial acceptance testing on a commercial subpanel feeder run before energizing. The project general contractor needs a formal signed test summary by end of day to approve closing the drywalled chase. The summary must clearly state test values, instrument details, and pass or fail status for each conductor.
delegate.inputs:
Field Test Log - Panel 2B Feeder Run (10/14/2024)
Tester: Megger MIT410/2, Cal exp: 08/2025. Fluke 87V, Cal exp: 03/2025.
Conductors: 4x 350 kcmil THHN Cu in 3-inch EMT. Run length: 145 ft.
Nominal system: 120/208V, 3-phase, 4-wire.

Megohmmeter Test @ 1000V DC (1-minute hold):
Phase A to Ground: 550 MΩ
Phase B to Ground: 620 MΩ
Phase C to Ground: 0.08 MΩ
Neutral to Ground: >999 MΩ
Phase A to Phase B: 850 MΩ
Phase B to Phase C: 780 MΩ
Phase A to Phase C: 910 MΩ

Continuity / Loop Resistance (Fluke 87V):
Phase A: 0.04 Ω
Phase B: 0.04 Ω
Phase C: 0.05 Ω
Neutral: 0.04 Ω

Notes from apprentice: Megger test conducted at 1000V DC on 600V rated THHN wire. Panel 2B is scheduled for full energization tomorrow morning 07:00.
delegate.goal: Deliver a concise, technically sound inspection report that highlights out-of-spec test measurements and identifies whether the installation is safe to energize.

criteria.text: Specifies the audience is the general contractor and the project electrical engineer.
Requires a structured report format with a pass/fail determination for each conductor.
Directs the AI to verify readings against standard insulation resistance thresholds and code minimums.
Instructs the AI to state whether the feeder is clear to energize based on test findings.

traps.description: Phase C to Ground insulation resistance is severely degraded and fails the standard 1.0 MΩ minimum, creating a ground fault hazard if energized.
The insulation resistance test voltage was set to 1000V DC on a 120/208V nominal system, which exceeds the standard 500V DC test level for 600V rated wiring.
